1e8o3um.description_en:
To all available contractors,
Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of materials which they believe could be essential for their experiments.
In particular, our scientists at [DESTINATION] have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.
For more information on the animals in question, refer to "Explorer's Guide to Harvestables" in your Journal.
Together we can make the universe better for all.
Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
1e8o3um.description_zh:
致所有有空的承包商，

拉亚利科学家们正努力解决再生技术失效的问题。目前，他们的工作因缺乏材料而受阻，他们认为这些物资可能对他们的实验至关重要。

特别是，我们在 [DESTINATION] 的科学家们因耗尽这些资源而不得不暂停工作。由于供应短缺，我们的常规供应商数月内无法供货，因此我们将为任何能协助补充这些物资的人提供丰厚报酬。

有关这些动物的更多信息，请参阅您日志中的《探险家的可采集物指南》。

携手共进，我们可以让宇宙变得更美好。

纳丽娜·勒雷姆
高级经理
临床研究外包

Vanduul have strange ways. I never talk to them, old souli used to, but not Wikelo. Anyway, though not friendly, they make interesting thing. If you like, Wikelo can make you look more like.
Bring things. Will do.
Bye.

带东西过来。我就做。

再见。

nvvtii.description_en:
One of our people is currently under attack at [LOCATION]. They have attempted to elude their attackers to get to safely, but the outlaws have proven too skilled for them to break away.
We need you to fly there, engage with the attackers, and then destroy the nearby fuel reserves. The hope is that this display of destruction will dissuade them from continuing pursuit.
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
nvvtii.description_zh:
我们的一名成员目前在 [LOCATION] 遭到攻击。他们试图躲避攻击者以安全撤离，但不法分子太过高明，导致他们无法摆脱。

我们需要你飞到那里，与攻击者交战，然后摧毁附近的燃料储备。希望这种破坏的展示能让他们放弃继续追击。

利马·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

4ptyc6.description_en:
Hey,
Got a contract for you that requires a bit more tactics than usual. A high-level criminal by the name [TARGET] is hiding with a large contingent of outlaws at [LOCATION].
Our intel suggests that [TARGET]’s forces most likely will act as defensive line in order to protect their boss. My best guess is that you will have to deal with them before you gain access to [TARGET].
That said, I don’t want you shooting indiscriminately. Sometimes these outlaws keep civilians around and they should be treated like non-combatants.
Best of luck,
Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group
4ptyc6.description_zh:
嘿，

有一份需要比平时更多策略的合约。一个叫做 [TARGETNAME] 的高等级罪犯正与大量非法分子躲藏在 [LOCATION]。

我们的情报显示出 [TARGETNAME] 的手下很可能是为了保护他们的老板而集结的。我猜你必须先解决掉他们才能找到 [TARGETNAME]。

话虽如此，我并不希望你进行无差别攻击。有时这些法外之徒身边会有一些平民，应该把他们当作非战斗人员。

祝你好运

布雷登·科查多
后勤官员 - 斯坦顿分部
北境之岩服务团队

8ni5ui.description_en:
Heyo,
Over at [LOCATION] we just got a refueling job for an entire small fleet of ships who all together need [FUELTYPE]. Talk about when it rains it pours!
The client will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
Unfortunately, where they're held up isn't the nicest of sectors so I'd be alert for any tomfoolery while you're doing the run.
It'll be best to try get them all back on their way as soon as you can.
Happy trails,
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
8ni5ui.description_zh:
嘿，

在 [LOCATION] 那边，我们刚接到一项为整支小型舰队加油的任务，他们一共需要 [FUELTYPE]。

客户飞船将按 [REFUELREQUEST] 的价格向你支付报酬。作为旅者联合俱乐部的承包商，完成任务后你还将获得上述列出的 UWC 服务费。

不幸的是，他们所在的区域并非什么好地方，因此你在干活期间务必要警惕任何不法分子的捣乱。

最好是尽快让他们全部恢复航行。

一路顺风，

迪娜·德洛特
调度中心
旅者联合俱乐部

5cw1sy.description_en:
As a consequence of the ongoing radiation storm on Pyro I, some of the invasive kopions have become irradiated. This poses a threat to the health of the indigenous wildlife and to those who live and work in [LOCATION].
We are seeking out a skilled contractor who can cull any irradiated kopions in and around [LOCATION]. Do not accept this contract unless you have the proper weapons and equipment that can reliably function in a radioactive environment.
Your compensation will be adjusted to match the risks associated with this contract.
Best,
Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists
5cw1sy.description_zh:
由于派罗 I 上频繁的辐射风暴，一些入侵的寇骈犬已经受到辐射污染。这对当地野生动物的健康以及生活和工作在 [LOCATION] 的人们构成了威胁。

我们正在寻找一位熟练的承包商，能够在 [LOCATION] 及其周边地区捕杀任何受辐射污染的寇骈犬。除非你拥有能在放射性环境中可靠运作的武器和装备，否则请勿接受此合约。
你的报酬将根据与本合约相关的风险进行调整。

祝好，

旺达·沃克海瑟
合约经理
高境荒野专家

5vub9k.description_en:
We've been having escalating issues with the outlaws at [LOCATION] and can no longer stand by and watch as their aggressive actions hurt our community.
We are wary of launching a full scale assault, but believe that if their fuel stores are wiped out, it would deter them from further hostile actions.
If you're able, I'd appreciate you handling the destruction of the fuel personally. A ship capable of launching missiles would probably make the most sense, but I leave that up to you.
Thanks,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
5vub9k.description_zh:
我们在 [LOCATION] 遇到的不法分子问题日益严重，我们不能再袖手旁观，任凭他们的侵略伤害我们的社区。

我们对发起全面攻击持谨慎态度，但我们相信如果能够摧毁他们的燃料储备，可以有效遏制进一步的敌对行动。

如果可以的话，我希望你能亲自处理燃料的摧毁。能发射导弹的飞船可能是最合适的选择，但我交给你来决定。

谢谢，

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

4y7ix6.description_en:
One of our pilots was supposed to bring a shipment back to us, but seems like he got into some trouble over at [LOCATION]. Either he got his brains blasted all over the cockpit, or freaked out and ditched his ship. For his sake, I hope it’s the first one so I don’t have the hunt this asshole down. twks8q.description_en:
So we were expecting a pretty important package earlier today but turns out the pilot got ghosted and they ripped the tracking chip from it and got away. Pretty clever right? Not really, because they forgot to take the flight recorder too.
Get the blackbox from the wreck at [LOCATION] and take it to [DESTINATION]. We’ll send you the creds when you’re done.
Oh and watch out for scavs, people are pretty desperate these days, even if it just some busted courier ship.
-Bit Zeros
twks8q.description_zh:
今天早些时候我们本该收到一个挺重要的包裹，结果飞行员直接跑路了，还把追踪芯片给撬了，挺机灵是吧？其实没那么聪明，因为他们忘了把飞行记录仪一块儿带走。

去 [LOCATION] 的残骸里把黑匣子捞出来，然后送到 [DESTINATION]，你干完活儿我们立马把酬金发你。

对了，小心点垃圾佬，现在这年头大家都快饿疯了，哪怕只是艘报废的快递船，也有人敢下手。

- 零比特

1d8mixu.description_en:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor
Case Update:
All your digging around Onyx has paid off. I’ve been able to confirm that Jorrit has been operating an off-the-record lab in the facility’s Site-B in order to conduct an experiment he calls “Project Hyperion.” I’ll send his lab notes to your mobiGlas journal once you’re underway, but the long and short of it is the bastard is trying to make Humans evolve or some nonsense like that.
The client wants the experimental data, so you’re going back to Onyx and do everything needed to get Project Hyperion up and running.
Contract Investigator Actions:
Prep the experiment by collecting a Reagent code from the Engineering wing and a Catalyst code from the Research wing.
Once you have those, head down to the Lab in Site-B and run the experiment so you can upload the results.
Additional Notes:
Since this is an active lab, there might be ASD security on-site.
Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.
1d8mixu.description_zh:
霍克罗事务所
案件文档 #JD10285
首席调查员：阿尔肯·马洛

案件更新：
你在玛瑙设施的深入调查终于有了收获。我已确认乔里特一直在站点-B 秘密运营着一个未登记的实验室，进行他称之为“海伯利安项目”的实验。等你出发后，我会把他的实验笔记发送到你的 mobiGlas 日志中，简单来说，这个混蛋想让人类进化，或者诸如此类的荒唐事。

客户需要这些实验数据，所以你得重返玛瑙设施，完成一切必要步骤，启动“海伯利安项目”。

合约调查员的行动：
先去工程区获取反应物代码，再去研究区获取催化剂代码，为实验做好准备。

拿到代码后，前往站点-B 的实验室，运行实验，然后上传实验结果。

补充说明：
由于这是个仍在运作的实验室，现场可能有联合科学与开发公司的安保人员。

前往玛瑙设施时，请使用可停放在大型机库的载具。

CONTRACTS & DISPATCH
CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = 1000
FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. The main contractor will also receive a bonus payment of 5 MG Scrip.

1mdipm0.description_en:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #MP66432
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor
Case Summary:
Need a skilled operator with combat experience to investigate the last known location of [TARGET]. Their employer hired us to look for they as they were carrying some highly valuable cargo, but the trackers have been disabled and the pilot is no longer responding.
We suspect that outlaws have attacked the ship and seized the cargo for themselves. The client has expressed that they consider the cargo lost but would like to know if the pilot is dead so they can inform their family.
Contract Investigator Actions:
Investigate [LOCATION] and locate the [TARGET]’s ship. If you are able to find the pilot’s body, confirm their status so we may inform the client.
Additional Notes:
Backup is highly recommended for this encounter.
1mdipm0.description_zh:
霍克罗事务所
案件文档 #MP66432
首席调查员：阿尔肯·马洛

案件摘要：
我们需要一名具有战斗经验的熟练调查员来调查 [TARGETNAME] 的最后已知位置。他们的雇主雇佣我们去找他们，因为他们当时正在运送一些高价值的物资。但是追踪设备已被破坏，飞行员也失去了联系。

我们怀疑不法分子袭击了飞船并抢走了货物。客户表示他们认为货物已经丢失，但希望知道飞行员是否遇难，以便通知他们的家人。

合约调查员的行动：
调查 [LOCATION]，找到 [TARGETNAME] 的飞船。如果能够找到飞行员的尸体，请确认他们的状况，以便我们通知客户。

补充说明：
此次行动强烈建议带上增援。

Hi,
Need a reliable contractor to pick up some packages for us and deliver them to their destination.
This route is a longer one so make sure you have enough fuel and don't forget a handheld tractor beam.
And not sure what you were planning on flying, but you'll need a ship that can transport [MAX_SCU] cargo containers
Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,
Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
Have a run here that could become a lucrative regular thing if we can pull it off. This’ll take you into Pyro, so you’ll have to be ready to tangle with some of the locals.
You’ll need to grab the stuff from [LOCATION], make the jump to Pyro, and then get to [DESTINATION].
All you need to do is bring a ship with space for 24 SCU cargo containers, a handheld tractor beam, and be ready to do some damage if someone picks a fight with you.
10son8u.description_zh:
红风物流
“您的货物，有我保障”
----------------------------

这儿有个活儿，要是能稳住就能变成个长期赚钱的买卖。这趟得进派罗，你得准备好跟当地那些人干一架。

你得先到 [LOCATION] 提货，跃迁到派罗，再赶到 [DESTINATION]。

你只需要一艘能装下 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸的集装箱的飞船，带个手持式牵引光束，要是有人找茬，也别怂，该打就打。

r6doq2.description_en:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
[LOCATION] Many of these ores are extremely rare and difficult to find, detectable only when a rock has been cracked open.
Reminder, all the materials must be refined before delivery, and since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

地点：[SYSTEM] 

条款*：
舒宾星际目前正在寻求完成另一份精炼材料采购订单。我们非常感谢您在此事上的帮助。

[HINT_LOCATION] 这些矿石中的许多都极为稀有且难以寻找，只有在岩石被破开时才能探测到。

提醒一下，所有材料必须在交付前进行精炼，并且由于这是一份采购订单而非采矿合约，你需要自备设备，例如[HINT_TOOL]。

*接受本合约即表示你原意承担与本合约所列工作相关的所有风险，舒宾星际在对任何在合约期间造成的损害概不负责。

nao6vh.description_en:
Hullo,
Crusader have been in touch to say that the scale of the damage to their platforms is greater than they initially thought and they'll need more propulsors than they originally estimated for.
We're contracting out their request to anyone with an available Item Fabricator standing by. Though I guess you could source the propulsors some other way, but that's on you.
Once ready, deliver them to [DESTINATION]. Payment sent on completion.
Ta very much,
Hal Grimsby
Contracts Manager
CORNERSTONE DEVELOPMENTS
"Building on the Foundations of our Past."
nao6vh.description_zh:
哈喽，

十字军方面已联系表示，他们平台受损程度比最初预估的更为严重，因此需要比原计划更多的推进器。

我们正委托任何有闲置物品制造机的承包商承接此需求。不过我猜你也可以通过其他渠道获取推进器，但这取决于你自己。

准备好后，请将它们运送到 [DESTINATION] 进行交付。任务完成后即支付报酬。

非常感谢，
哈尔·格里姆斯比
合约经理

基石开发公司

1afadt9.description_en:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
One of our haulers ran into some engine trouble whilst transporting some cargo for us and was forced to abandon their ship. Looking for a contractor who can recover the cargo and complete the delivery. You’ll need to bring your own heavy-duty tractor beam to transport the cargo to your ship. Details below.
RECOVERY LOCATION
· [LOCATION]
DROP OFF LOCATION
· Freight elevator at [DESTINATION]
Be advised, the recovery location hasn’t been verified as safe. You might find an opportunistic outlaw trying to take the cargo for themselves, so be on alert.
TAKE PRIDE IN YOUR WORK – Even as a contractor you are representing Red Wind Linehaul. Do not intentionally do anything to harm the company’s reputation.
1afadt9.description_zh:
红风物流
“您的货物，有我保障”
----------------------------

找回地点
     · [LOCATION]

卸货地点
     · [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯

请注意，打捞地点的安全性尚未确认。你可能会遇到趁火打劫的不法分子企图抢走货物，务必提高警惕。

以你的工作为荣 - 即使你是外包承包商，你也代表红风货运。切勿故意做出任何损害公司声誉的行为。

egb06v.description_en:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer
> About the job <
RSI have informed us that there has been an increase in owners exchanging their ships in order to upgrade to the latest Constellation Mk V Centaurus and are looking for our help in salvaging the retired crafts. The exchange program only accepts Construction Materials (Salvage), so RSI have informed us that the contractor may keep any RMC they collect.
If accepted, you will travel to [LOCATION] and gather unrefined Construction Materials from the ship located there. Then, once acquired, deliver the materials to the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION]. Please be mindful that any extra materials delivered will not be returned.
For advice on salvaging, consult A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection in your mobiGlas journal. Check the requirements below to ensure you bring the right equipment.
> Requirements <
- A large-sized salvage ship (Aegis Reclaimer)
- A handheld tractor beam
> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

h0l3tt.description_en:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH
CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = 1000
FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING
A client of ours has been receiving anonymous threats in an attempt to blackmail them, and after a bit of leg work on our part, we’ve managed to trace it back to an individual who pilots a particular [TARGET]. The client wants us to take care of this blackmailer before they have a chance to make good.
Based on our assessment, the target shouldn’t be too difficult to handle. They fly by [LOCATION] on the regular, which has an emission cloud that’s an ideal spot to power down your ship and lie in wait. Sometimes the target is alone but they often travel with other single-seat ships as protection. Best be strategic when you launch your ambush or the [TARGET] could have a chance to get away. We don’t want to lose this one. We’ll alert other contractors in the area of the ambush so they can come help once it pops off.
Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. The client has also added a bonus payment of 3 MG Scrip for the main contractor.
This contract is non-negotiable.
This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

qt1vfv.description_en:
Hey again,
I've got a beacon at [LOCATION] and this one's a bit more complicated than usual. Got small convoy of ships requesting [FUELTYPE]. Impressive coordination and lack of planning to all need refueling at the same time.
The client will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
Hopefully since the area they're in is pretty safe, there shouldn't be too much trouble lurking, but these days you never know. Wouldn't hurt to get them back flying again as quick as you're able.
Happy trails,
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
qt1vfv.description_zh:
嘿你好，

我有一个在 [LOCATION] 那的信标，这次的任务比平时复杂一些。有一支小型舰队请求补充 [FUELTYPE]。他们协调性好的出奇，计划性又差得离谱。

客户飞船将按 [REFUELREQUEST] 的价格向你支付报酬。作为旅者联合俱乐部的承包商，完成任务后你还将获得上述列出的 UWC 服务费。

所幸他们所在的区域安全一些，不太会有麻烦潜伏，但如今世事难料。还是尽快让他们恢复航行比较好。

再见。

1bqthkt.description_en:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
[LOCATION] Many of these ores are extremely rare and difficult to find, detectable only when a rock has been cracked open.
Reminder, all the materials must be refined before delivery, and since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

地点：[SYSTEM] 

条款*：
舒宾星际目前正在寻求完成另一份精炼材料采购订单。我们非常感谢您在此事上的帮助。

[HINT_LOCATION] 这些矿石中的许多都极为稀有且难以寻找，只有在岩石被破开时才能探测到。

提醒一下，所有材料必须在交付前进行精炼，并且由于这是一份采购订单而非采矿合约，你需要自备设备，例如[HINT_TOOL]。

Need a contractor for a simple cargo haul going from a freight elevator at [LOCATION] to a freight elevator at [DESTINATION]. At most the containers will be 4 SCU in size.
Also, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.
Any chance you’re available to take care of it for us?
[SIGN_OFF]
Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.
1lvrfd4.description_zh:
哈喽，

需要一位承包商来一次简单的运货，从 [LOCATION] 的货运电梯送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯。尺寸最大不超过 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 的集装箱。

顺便提醒，我们强烈建议承包商随身携带手持式牵引光束。

你能帮我们处理一下吗？

[CONTRACTOR]

蔡斯·休伊特
初级物流协调员
科瓦莱什货运
“尽你所需，达你所在。”


科瓦莱什货运是一家有限责任公司，为鼓励及时交付和防止货运欺诈，科瓦莱什货运将设定交货时间限制。到期后，任何未交付的货物将被视为被盗。总酬金将会根据货物成功交付的百分比按比例支付。

Greetings,
Seems like [LOCATION] currently has some 4 SCU or smaller cargo that needs to be separated and delivered to a few different spots.
DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)
- Freight elevator at [DESTINATION]
- Freight elevator at [DESTINATION1]
Drop-offs can be done in whatever order works best for you.
By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.
